_comment: Ported from BOSS in Parlour v23.dc.html (line ~1479). Always the final (8th) knock of night 3.

boss.name: Mayor Havel
boss.role: HE PAID IN ADVANCE, WHICH IS ITS OWN KIND OF THREAT
boss.brings: The ledger is a record, nothing more. I am protecting the village, not the name. Thirty years is too long to undo, and she never asked me for anything.
boss.win: He says the name out loud at the town hall. It is a catastrophe and a relief and the village never recovers or wants to.
boss.fail: He reads the ledger aloud instead. Every fortune in the village, side by side, in your own words.
